sources.title: Qwen 3.5 9B by Alibaba — Text Generation | VeniceStats
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5 9B is a compact model from Alibaba's Qwen team, part of the Qwen 3.5 series and published under the Apache 2.0 license in early 2026. It is built around a hybrid architecture that pairs Gated DeltaNet linear attention with full-attention layers, a design aimed at efficient processing across very long inputs.
